npcs.name: Captain Bramble
npcs.title: Gate Captain of Buckleburg
npcs.greeting: Halt! Oh, it's you. Carry on. Heroically.
barks: Keep your bow strung and your boots laced.
I'd go myself, but somebody has to guard this... gate.
Report any goblins. Or bears. ESPECIALLY bears.

npcs.name: Hilda Hammerbottom
npcs.title: Blacksmith
barks: Rocks are just ore that hasn't met me yet.
Hmph. Your bow needs more hitting.

npcs.name: Granny Gristle
npcs.title: Herbalist (Mostly Licensed)
npcs.greeting: Come in, dearie. Don't touch the purple jar.
barks: A potion a day keeps the goblins at bay. Mostly.
Sniffleleaf! Achoo! That's how you know it's fresh.
Have you eaten? You look peckish. And stabbed.

npcs.name: Pip Puddlefoot
npcs.title: Traveling Merchant (Currently Stationary)
npcs.greeting: Oh thank goodness, a hero! My wagon! My wheels! My dignity!
barks: They took my left wheel. Who needs ONE wheel?!
I'll pay! In coins! And gratitude! Mostly coins!
Is it safe? It's not safe. Is it safe now?
